limitations: A linear sweep is not a full control-flow recovery: jump targets, jump tables, overlapping encodings and data-in-.text can desynchronise the cursor. Unknown opcodes advance one byte and are counted separately. Same-function CPUID is the only dispatch signal; a dispatcher that calls a leaf holding AVX/BMI is not detected here. FDE extents are unwind-described ranges, not validated function boundaries. No equivalence with reconstructed Rust is established.
